question: The first Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award was given to which of the following sports person?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Vishwanathan Anand.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna** award was given to** Vishwanathan Anand **in the year** 1991-92.**
 
• Vishwanathan Anand is an **Indian chess grandmaster** and former **World Chess Champion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Major Dhyanchand was a** legendary Indian field hockey player** who won** three Olympic gold medals** in** 1928, 1932 and 1936.**
 
• Sachin Tendulkar is a **former Indian cricketer **and widely regarded as one of the** greatest batsmen** in the history of cricket.
 
• Saina Nehwal is an** Indian badminton player** who has won numerous international titles including the **bronze medal** at the 2012 London Olympics.
 
• Therefore, the** correct **answer is option 3 - Vishwanathan Anand.
